# redirhub_domain (Data Source)

A domain already connected to the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "redirhub_domain" "go" {
  host = "go.example.com"
}

output "points_to_redirhub" {
  value = data.redirhub_domain.go.dns_ok
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String)

### Read-Only

- `dns_ok` (Boolean)
- `dns_records` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `force_https` (Boolean)
- `https` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `short_links` (Boolean)
